data.source: Drone-based Agricultural Dataset for Crop Yield Estimation, cashew parts: close-range drone photos of cashew trees in Ghana (1600x1300) and Uganda (640x480 copy), YOLO boxes with four fruit stages

rule.split: by source photo (sha256 of seed, source and file name), 70/15/15; no photo appears in two splits

label_orders.alpha: flower, premature, unripe, ripe, spoilt, tree (ids 0 to 5)
label_orders.paper: tree, flower, premature, unripe, ripe, spoilt (ids 0 to 5)

real_video_backgrounds.from: potato sorting clips of the set usda_line_videos; the citrus and apple clips are held out for testing

data.sampling: each epoch draws 9000 training crops with equal weight for every class and, inside a class, for every source
data.selection: checkpoint with best validation balanced accuracy; temperature fitted on validation; test used once
data.split: by source photo (sha256 of seed, source and file name), 70/15/15; no photo appears in two splits
